description: This file is a shell script used for telemetry data collection, configuration, and management in a device. It includes functions for cleanup, configuration generation, scheduling, and communication with other system components, as well as logic for handling telemetry data and triggering uploads.

methods.name: dcaCleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of telemetry markers and notifies ARM if multi-core is supported.

methods.name: clearTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Removes telemetry configuration and marker files, resets telemetry directories.

methods.name: generateTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Generates telemetry configuration files based on input JSON profile.

methods.name: scheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules or reschedules the cron job for telemetry based on configuration.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Restarts dropbear SSH server if not running.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file for the script.

methods.name: getEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of erouter0.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address of erouter0.

methods.name: getSNMPUpdates
methods.description: Performs SNMP walk to get specific MIB values and sums them.

methods.name: getRFStatus
methods.description: Retrieves RF status parameters via SNMP.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes JSON response file, extracts and reformats data for telemetry.
